items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: McLaughlin is not a jazz guy.

ctx.x: Yeah, but that meeting, what did you talk about?

Hi. How are you doing? What are you listening to? I said, “I don’t really like Bitches Brew.” He said, “I love Bitches Brew. You might have to rethink that.” I said, “Might have to. No problem, I’ll check it out. What am I missing?” He said, “Oh, it’s like the link between jazz and pop.” I said, “It’s really not.” He says, “Well, I still think it’s a good record. How can you say that it’s not?” I said, “Because there were really no….” The rhythm section wasn’t a jazz rhythm section. It wasn’t like a bunch of jazz…
Harvey Brooks. Electric bass was Harvey Brooks.
